meta.name: Shikara
meta.description: Shikara is the untold story of Kashmiri Pandits' forced exodus. It is the story of resilience in the face of insurmountable odds. It is also the story of a love that remains unextinguished through 30 years of exile. A timeless love story in the worst of times.
meta.slogan: The Untold Story of Kashmiri Pandits
